data.gender_notes: Ateefah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘atafaa’, meaning to comfort, console, or relieve. In Islamic tradition, Ateefah is a name given to a girl who is expected to bring comfort and solace to those around her. The name Ateefah carries the meaning “Comforting, Consoling” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ateefah usually hope their child will grow to embody comforting, consoling and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of compassion and comfort in times of need.
data.etymology: Ateefah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comforting, Consoling.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ateefah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
